Antoni van Leeuwenhoek
Department of Radiology
Date: 28 Jan 2025
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: PSA 8.6 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 4+3. Evaluate for focal lesion and local staging.

FINDINGS:
The prostate volume is 42.65 mL. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal hypo-intense lesion in the mid right peripheral zone, measuring approximately 14 x 12 mm. On diffusion-weighted imaging, this region shows marked restricted diffusion with low ADC values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences confirm early and intense focal enhancement corresponding to the DWI abnormality. No evidence of extracapsular extension, seminal vesicle invasion, or suspicious pelvic lymphadenopathy is identified.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the mid right peripheral zone.
PSAD: 0.202 ng/mL/mL.
Clinical T stage: cT2a.
csPCa predicted probability 0.8539465.

previous_notes.author: Dr. R. van den Berg (GP)
previous_notes.text:
19 Aug 2023 - Dr. R. van den Berg (GP):
Patient presented with elevated PSA of 6.5 ng/mL. After discussion, a transrectal ultrasound-guided biopsy was arranged. Results confirmed prostate cancer, Gleason 4+3. The patient was referred to urology for further evaluation and treatment planning. He was advised to monitor symptoms and report any urinary changes.

previous_notes.author: Dr. R. van den Berg (GP)
previous_notes.text:
12 Oct 2024 - Dr. R. van den Berg (GP):
Follow-up visit for prostate cancer surveillance. PSA measured at 3.3 ng/mL, which was unexpected given the previous trend. The patient reports no new symptoms. He continues to swim once weekly and maintains a healthy lifestyle. Referred to urology for re-evaluation and discussion of treatment options.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (19 Aug 2023):
Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+3, corresponding to ISUP grade group 3. The malignant glands exhibit a growth pattern that is partly cribriform and partly irregular tubules. High-risk features are noted, specifically the presence of a cribriform pattern. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, mid right.

Trajectory across timepoints:
The histological findings remain consistent with the initial diagnosis, showing no change in grade or pattern across the available biopsy material.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 2.
